skills.name: antislop

skills.name: antislop-code
skills.description: Code comment hygiene for AI coding agents: remove generic AI-slop comments, keep the valuable ones, never touch the code.

skills.name: antislop-copywriting
skills.description: Copy and text skill for antislop. Use when writing or editing prose: headlines, tone, CTAs, and anti-AI-writing patterns. Load with the core.

skills.name: antislop-human
skills.description: Human and accessibility skill for antislop. Contrast, keyboard, focus, and states for real people. Includes the contrast checker.

skills.name: antislop-layoutmobile
skills.description: Mobile layout skill for antislop. Use for layouts that reflow on small screens: grids, overflow, tap targets. Load with the core.

skills.name: antislop-ui
skills.description: UI and visual skill for antislop. Use when building or editing any interface: color, layout, components, motion. Load with the core.

skills.name: css-protips
skills.description: A collection of CSS protips to take CSS skills pro: CSS resets, box-sizing inheritance, :not(), :is(), aspect-ratio, the lobotomized owl selector, comma-separated lists, SVG icons, vertical centering, and more.

skills.name: hallmark
skills.description: Anti-AI-slop design skill for greenfield pages, audits, redesigns, and design extraction from URLs or screenshots. Insists on structural variety — pages should feel like different sites, not colour-swaps of the same template.

skills.name: impeccable
skills.description: Design guidance for AI coding agents: 22 commands for frontend design, audit, critique, and polish, with live browser iteration and deterministic anti-pattern detection. Covers websites, landing pages, dashboards, product UI, app shells, components, forms, settings, onboarding, and empty states.

skills.name: ponytail
skills.description: Lazy senior dev mode: forces the laziest solution that actually works — YAGNI, stdlib before custom code, native platform features before dependencies, one line before fifty. Levels: lite, full (default), ultra.

skills.name: ponytail-audit
skills.description: Whole-repo audit for over-engineering, like ponytail-review but repo-wide: a ranked list of what to delete, simplify, or replace with stdlib/native equivalents. One-shot report, applies nothing.

skills.name: ponytail-debt
skills.description: Harvest every `ponytail:` comment in the codebase into a debt ledger so deliberate shortcuts and deferrals get tracked instead of rotting into 'later means never'. One-shot report, changes nothing.

skills.name: ponytail-gain
skills.description: Show ponytail's measured impact as a compact scoreboard: less code, less cost, more speed, from the published benchmark medians. One-shot display, not a per-repo number.

skills.name: ponytail-help
skills.description: Quick-reference card for all ponytail modes, skills, and commands. One-shot display, does not change mode.

skills.name: ponytail-review
skills.description: Code review focused exclusively on over-engineering: what to delete, reinvented standard library, unneeded dependencies, speculative abstractions, dead flexibility. One line per finding: location, what to cut, what replaces it.

skills.name: supanova-design-engine
skills.description: Supanova Landing Page Design Engine. Generates premium, conversion-optimized landing pages using pure HTML + Tailwind CSS (CDN). Overrides default LLM biases toward generic templates; enforces metric-based design rules, Korean typography standards, and hardware-accelerated motion.

skills.name: supanova-full-output
skills.description: Overrides default LLM truncation behavior. Enforces complete HTML generation with zero placeholder patterns. Every landing page must be delivered as a complete, production-ready file. No shortcuts, no skeletons, no 'add more as needed' patterns.

skills.name: supanova-premium-aesthetic
skills.description: Teaches AI to design landing pages that feel like $150k agency work: exact fonts, spacing, shadows, card structures, animations, and Korean typography standards. Blocks all common defaults that make AI designs look cheap or generic.

skills.name: supanova-redesign-engine
skills.description: Upgrades existing landing pages to premium quality. Audits current design for generic AI patterns and applies Supanova's high-end standards. Works with any HTML/CSS landing page — Tailwind, vanilla CSS, or inline styles.
